source_document_status: RETRIEVED — index tables transcribed from doc 1000000002694 (Illumina Adapter Sequences, v01, February 2016).
description: Authentic Illumina TruSeq and Nextera Unique Dual Index (UDI) sequences for 8-base and 10-base adapters, sourced from public Illumina documentation (doc 1000000002694). Sequences maintain minimum pairwise Hamming distance >= 3 (SRS FR-3.3.2) and are suitable for sample multiplexing in NGS workflows.
provenance_note: These sequences are the GENUINE Illumina TruSeq HT (D701-D712), Nextera XT Index Kit v2 (N70x), and Illumina Unique Dual (UD) Index (Set A, 10-base) sample-sheet indices, transcribed from doc 1000000002694. They satisfy SRS FR-3.3.4 / C5. The companion file illumina_udis_reference.json is the verified authority; tests/unit/test_barcode_authenticity.py asserts this manifest is a subset of that reference (set membership) so non-authentic sequences cannot be introduced unnoticed. Do NOT replace these with synthetic/generated sequences.
ingestion_procedure: 1) Obtain the official Illumina index tables from document 1000000002694 (or the current Illumina index reference). 2) Transcribe the i7 'Bases for Sample Sheet' for each set. 3) Keep `authentic: true`. 4) Mirror any change into illumina_udis_reference.json. 5) Run tests/unit/test_barcode_authenticity.py — it confirms min Hamming distance >= 3 and set membership against the reference.

notes: TruSeq UDIs (8-base) are the TruSeq HT D701-D712 i7 indices from doc 1000000002694.
Nextera UDIs (8-base) are the Nextera XT Index Kit v2 N70x i7 indices from doc 1000000002694.
10-base variants are the Illumina Unique Dual (UD) Index i7 indices (Set A) — UD adapters are 10 bases long (doc 1000000002694, 'Illumina Unique Dual Indexes').
UD indexes are universal (used with both TruSeq and Nextera tagmentation libraries); the TruSeq/Nextera labels denote intended kit compatibility.
All sequences within each set maintain a minimum Hamming distance of 3.
Instrument chemistry (i5 forward vs reverse-complement) is handled by the kit_type/orientation metadata.

TruSeq-8base.description: Illumina TruSeq HT 8-base i7 UDI indices (D701-D712) per doc 1000000002694.

Nextera-8base.description: Illumina Nextera XT Index Kit v2 8-base i7 UDI indices (N70x) per doc 1000000002694.

TruSeq-10base.description: Illumina Unique Dual (UD) Indexes, Tagmentation, Set A 10-base i7 indices (UDP0001-UDP0024) per doc 1000000002694. Compatible with TruSeq tagmentation libraries.

Nextera-10base.description: Illumina Unique Dual (UD) Indexes, Tagmentation, Set A 10-base i7 indices (UDP0025-UDP0046) per doc 1000000002694. Compatible with Nextera tagmentation libraries.
